policy: Every required detector must distinguish a concrete important failure; identical parameter products are not a coverage obligation.

changes.failure: A failed, panicking or replayed successor registration/activation/Join must not authorize extra dispatch, lose the original cleanup, or misstate native ownership.

changes.after: Memory keeps all 28 histories. Each SQL backend retains both origins and rows (0,0),(1,1),(1,2),(1,5),(2,1),(2,2),(3,1),(3,2): 16 histories, with every assertion unchanged.
changes.rationale: Fault-store panic points 3/4 run before invoking the inner Store or after its awaited operation has completed, outside any live SQL transaction. Returned authority/receipt values contain metadata, not pooled connections. The shared Runtime unwind adapter remains covered by all Memory panic rows; SQL points 1/2 retain the same pre-call/completed-call uncertainty states, and registration point 5 retains actual native replay. changes.validation: All three retained core families passed once serially and once at four scheduler slots: 28 Memory and 16 histories per SQL backend. Native wall times were43.857s serial and21.536s parallel. Each run created and finished its one PostgreSQL history fixture, cleaned its owned run/server, and left its container absent. This is partial changed-family validation; complete and affected-rebuild qualification remain pending. Prior full-run timings are not a controlled critical-path comparison.

changes.failure: A malformed Join acknowledgement must not release the original physical proof, change retry identity, or repeat business dispatch even though native Join committed.
changes.before: Each backend repeats nine returned-receipt field mutations for both keyed and unkeyed initial admission: 18 histories.
changes.after: Memory keeps all 18 histories. Each SQL backend retains both origins with wrong termination (1) and wrong owner target (8): four histories. All original assertions and deadlines remain.
changes.rationale: The test wrapper changes only an in-memory returned SessionOwnerReceipt after genuine native Join has completed. No mutation changes persisted SQL data, backend authentication or an in-flight transaction. All nine negative field comparisons belong to the shared Runtime retirement predicate and remain covered on Memory. Each retained SQL case proves persisted Joined state, a still-pending original proof after150ms, identical repeated Join keys, exactly one business/provider effect, and eventual completion only after clearing the corruption. That genuine SQL Replay must pass all nine positive comparisons. Native SQL driver fault/cold-replay/protection and real persisted owned-scope source/Join-hash corruption and process histories remain required.
changes.validation: All three retained ACK families passed once serially and once at four scheduler slots: 18 Memory and four histories per SQL backend. Each run created and finished one owned PostgreSQL fixture, cleaned its run/server and left its container absent. Every real Replay still passed the complete retirement predicate. This is partial changed-family validation; complete-budget and affected-rebuild qualification remain pending.

changes.after: All twelve on Memory for every origin; forged receipt revision (0) and suspended/wrong typed outcome (8) on both SQL backends for every origin.
changes.rationale: Completed::new, Source::metadata, claim-token/run/root-join checks and metadata/inspection equality are shared Rust pending execution code, independent of Store backend. SQL retains authentic preparation/commit/inspection followed by zero-register and zero-business-effect assertions for both a forged receipt and an invalid outcome on each of four independently authenticated origins. changes.failure: State must survive independent PerCall Agent runs; real host state imports must enforce entry, value and key bounds without applying refused writes.

changes.validation: New real WASM host-boundary/counter and shortAgent cases passed; native pending families passed33selected cases at1and4 onMemory/SQLite andMemory/PostgreSQL;32matchedPGfixturepairs and2ownedcontainersverifiedgone. changes.failure: Completion/inspection/main must share the actual task; held ACK cancellation cannot dispatch; committed replay cannot repeat effects; blocked cleanup must retain ownership until actual release.
changes.before: Each of four origins bundles success, held-stage faults, malformed ACK/replay and blocked cleanup into one sequential Store history.
changes.after: Each origin has independently scheduled success/replay, held-ACK, malformed/replay and cleanup tests, each with fresh Store/clock. Current PostgreSQL clones reuse the already migrated template.
changes.rationale: The helpers preserve their assertions and internal task/join order. Separate families share no IDs, receipts, tasks or database state. Migration is not asserted in these wrappers; dedicated migration cases retain real migration calls.
changes.validation: New real WASM host-boundary/counter and shortAgent cases passed; native pending families passed33selected cases at1and4 onMemory/SQLite andMemory/PostgreSQL;32matchedPGfixturepairs and2ownedcontainersverifiedgone. changes.failure: SQLite libraries must compile without a PostgreSQL driver; CLI constructors and external WASM embedding must work in their selected feature graphs.
changes.before: Narrow library/CLI feature checks compile their full private integration/unit suites, plus wasm_state and wasm_roles are rebuilt in two narrower facade graphs.
changes.after: One driver-free SQLite library graph also compiles crabber-obs without OTLP. Combined behavior and actual normal CLI builds own constructor match arms; the standalone external consumer owns real WASM-only embedding. Custom-HTTP positive/negative probes retain every visibility assertion.
changes.rationale: server-host-probe main.rs has only sqlite/postgres conditional match arms; both compile in the combined graph. It has no wasm conditional CLI arm. workspace-context-probe is a library and its SQLite-enabled behavior compiles and runs in the combined graph. There were no negative CLI visibility assertions in the removed positive cargo-check commands. External host still builds/executes the facade with wasm+otlp+custom-http and no SQL drivers; the locked server-host consumer remains a genuine separate public consumer. The custom-http probe retains all positive/negative provider API diagnostics. crabber-obs has only two OTLP gates, at its telemetry module and reexports; its production library without OTLP now shares the driver-free SQLite graph, while its private tests run once with the combined graph. No assertion helper, doctest or actual executable journey was removed.
